data.name: Between Stops
data.detailed_description:
Release Date

Between Stops is officially releasing in just over a month. Play the Demo May 8 2026!


About the Game

Between Stops is a story-driven RPG where every choice shapes how the world responds to you.

After falling asleep on a late-night subway, you and your friend Sakou awaken in a strange world that shouldn’t exist. A world created by forgotten gods. A world on the verge of being erased.

To survive, and to find a way home, you must navigate unfamiliar cities, confront dangerous enemies, and decide how you will treat the people who stand in your way.

 Gameplay Features

  • Turn-Based RPG Combat inspired by Deltarune's combat,
    Dodge enemy attacks in real-time during their turn while choosing how to respond during yours. With new added features, such as parrying, supporting, and small rhythm mechanics.

  • Multiple Routes & Consequences
    Your actions dramatically alter character relationships, boss fights, and entire story outcomes.

  • Character-Driven Storytelling
    Develop bonds with a cast of flawed, evolving characters, including Sakou, Strivain, and others whose fates depend on your decisions.

  • Challenging Boss Encounters
    Unique multi-phase battles with custom mechanics and emotional narrative weight.

Will you protect this world…

Or let it be destroyed like it was meant to so long ago?

data.short_description: Between Stops is a story-driven turn-based RPG with bullet-hell inspired combat. Dodge deadly boss patterns, shape character relationships, and unlock multiple routes where your choices permanently alter the story.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-level (quad-core) or equivalent AMD
  • Memory: 4000 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Any GPU supporting OpenGL 3.3+ / Vulkan capable (most GPUs made after ~2012)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 800 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • VR Support: None
  • Additional Notes: This game uses the Godot 4 renderer (Vulkan). Older GPUs without Vulkan support may experience issues.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 / AMD Ryzen 3 or better
  • Memory: 8000 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU or modern integrated GPU
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 800 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • VR Support: None
  • Additional Notes: Updating graphics drivers is recommended.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.15 (Catalina)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or Apple Silicon (M1 or newer)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-compatible graphics card
  • Storage: 800 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated audio
  • Additional Notes: Compatible with Metal-supported Macs.
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 12 (Monterey) or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or Apple M1 / newer
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Core i5 or Apple M1 / newer
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated audio
  • Additional Notes: Apple Silicon supported.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 / SteamOS / modern Linux distro
  • Processor: Dual Core 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.3 compatible GPU
  • Storage: 800 MB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 or newer
  • Processor: Quad Core 2.5 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.3 compatible GPU
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: The choices you make can lead to Death, Murder, and Suicide.
